title: Context Engineering: The Most Important Skill for AI-Era Developers
summary: Anthropic's 2026 report calls context engineering the most impactful skill shift for AI-era developers. Here's what it means, how it differs from prompt engineering, and how to implement the 4-layer framework.
body_markdown: MCP (Model Context Protocol) gives your agent live access to your actual systems instead of forcing it to infer from static files. With MCP connections, your agent reads your real database schema, sees live GitHub issues and PRs, and knows your actual deployed state. This removes an entire category of errors caused by agents reasoning from outdated or incomplete information. For Claude Code and Cursor users, Blink's MCP plugin provides 80+ tools covering database, auth, backend, and hosting — install with` npx skills add blink-new/blink-plugin` .
